en.t: Still, you must not lose heart.

units.source_text: 漂流者因饥渴而倒下，与其说是生理上的欠缺，倒不如说是出于对“欠缺”的恐怖。

en.t: When castaways collapse from hunger and thirst, it is less from a physical lack than from the terror of that lack.

units.source_text: 正因为你想到输了，所以你才会败北。

en.t: It is precisely because you think of defeat that you will be defeated.

units.source_text: 汗滴从鼻子尖上啪嗒啪嗒地掉下。

en.t: Drops of sweat fell plop by plop from the tip of his nose.

units.source_text: 你要是小心翼翼地担心着又失去了多少CC的水分，那可是正中了敌人的下怀。

en.t: If you timidly worry over how many more cubic centimeters of water you have lost, you are playing straight into the enemy's hands.

units.source_text: 还是想想一杯水蒸发要花多少时间的好。

en.t: Better instead to think about how long it takes for a cup of water to evaporate.

units.source_text: 也别去不必要地闹事，别去鞭策那匹称作“时间”的马。

en.t: And do not stir up needless trouble; do not whip the horse called time.
